mobbin:74bc6276-56b0-44b9-9a2b-cd8ed27f6.summary: From event details the host taps Check In Guests, opens the QR camera, confirms the identified guest on a sheet, sees Check In Successful, can Undo, then returns to the viewfinder for the next scan.
steal: Scan → identify sheet → explicit Check In (steps 1–2) — confirm before state change (maps to equipment check-out).
List icon beside the viewfinder (steps 1, 5) — manual fallback when the code won’t scan.
Green Check In Successful banner that keeps the camera live (steps 3–4) — high-throughput continuous scan.
Undo Check In with Registered / Checked In times (step 4) — instant correction for wrong scan / already-in edge.
avoid: No unrecognized-code or already-checked-in error sheet in this flow (steps 1–5) — only happy path + Undo after success.
mobbin:74bc6276-56b0-44b9-9a2b-cd8ed27f6.fit: Extends Baseline check-out-auto: host QR scan stands in for barcode/NFC on kit → identify item → confirm → success; Undo covers mis-scan; list fallback covers failed scan.
